title: Lahaina water use permit applications and TIG report
summary: On August 23 the board voted unanimously to approve the Temporary Investigative Group (TIG) report on water use permit applications in the Lahaina surface and groundwater management area, and it will be sent to Commission on Water Resource Management (CWRM). The report found requests of almost 9 million gallons a day, 213% of reported existing use, and urged reviewing surface and groundwater applications together. A member said the permit process will need attention for years, maybe decades.
